groups.title: Bands, Bars and Washes
groups.theme: Layered stripes and blocks of color, soft washes, grids and plaids: marks laid side by side until they build a surface.

groups.title: Splatter, Scribble and Swirl
groups.theme: Marks thrown, dripped, scribbled and spun: crowds of lines, splashes on bare ground, and masses that turn in circles.
